description: Delete a markdown note — a plain (non-task) note OR a TaskNotes file — by its vault-relative PATH. MOVES the file into the vault-local .trash/ folder (recoverable, not a permanent unlink) and cleans up every dangling reference vault-wide: strips dependsOn/projects entries on OTHER tasks and UNLINKS body/prose [[wikilink]]/[display](path) references to plain text (their display text). confirm_title is REQUIRED and must equal the note's display name (its filename without the .md extension). Chain if_hash from a prior read for optimistic concurrency. The response reports trashed_path plus per-REFERENCE cleanup counts. dry_run:true computes and returns the counts + trash destination WITHOUT writing anything.

confirm_title.description:
Required guard: the note's DISPLAY NAME — its filename WITHOUT the
`.md` extension (e.g. `Draft` for `Projects/Draft.md`). A mismatch
refuses the delete, catching a wrong/hallucinated path.

dry_run.description:
Preview only — compute and return the reference-cleanup counts +
trash destination WITHOUT writing to disk (no move, no rewrite). The
response carries `dry_run: true`.

if_hash.description:
Opt-in compare-and-swap: the note's expected content digest (from a
prior read). A mismatch refuses the delete.

name: delete_note
